connection.U0dMYW5nUmVzdENsaWVudA.scheme.source:
A connection to an [SGLang](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang) model server.

SGLang exposes an OpenAI-compatible API at `/v1/*` plus SGLang-native endpoints (`/generate` for constrained decoding, `/get_server_info`, `/flush_cache`).

The target instance serves exactly one model; the `model` option is required.  If the deployment requires authentication, set `apikey`.

The connection uses the `sglang://` URL scheme for plain HTTP and `sglangs://` for servers behind TLS.
